title: Updates regarding the nuovo iphone 18 pro max and iPhone 17 pricing
description: Reports suggest the iPhone 18 Pro is coming with limited stock, while iPhone 17 prices may rise soon. A foldable iPhone faces delays.

sections.heading: iPhone 18 Pro Availability
paragraphs: According to Fastweb, the iPhone 18 Pro is arriving. However, the source indicates that availability for the device might be limited.

sections.heading: iPhone 17 Price Changes
paragraphs: HDblog.it reports that Apple might increase prices for the iPhone 17. The source suggests this price adjustment could happen in a few days.

sections.heading: Foldable iPhone Development
paragraphs: Yellow.com states that the foldable iPhone remains stalled. The report attributes this situation to $1 billion of incomplete Apple chips.

sections.heading: Search Interest
